Residence Life and Housing
DiNardo Hall, Rm 100
115A Burrill Avenue
Bridgewater, MA 02325
508.531.1277

Approximately 3,300 undergraduate students live on campus in 11 residence halls, which are differentiated by type of rooms and living arrangements and the class standing of residents. Most first-year students live in Shea and Durgin Halls.

Miles Hall

University Park (East Campus)
Miles Hall, a co-ed residence, houses upper-class students on four floors. Miles and DiNardo halls are mirror images of each other separated by a courtyard. Rooms are arranged as doubles and/or triples and share a common room. This residence hall is located on East Campus across the street from the Moakley Center and next to East Campus Commons, the closest dining hall.

Available Room Types:
Suite Style with Living Room and Shared Single-Sex Bathrooms on Each Wing

Amenities:
Study Lounge on Each Floor, Kitchen on Ground Floor, Game Room

Class Standings:
Upper Class

DiNardo Hall

University Park (East Campus)
DiNardo Hall, a co-ed residence, houses upper-class students on four floors. DiNardo and Miles halls are mirror images of each other separated by a courtyard. Rooms are arranged as doubles and/or triples and share a common room. This residence hall is located on East Campus across the street from the Moakley Center and next to East Campus Commons, the closest dining hall.

Available Room Types:
Suite Style with Living Room and Shared Single-Sex Bathrooms on Each Wing

Amenities:
Study Lounge on Each Floor, Kitchen on Ground Floor, Game Room

Class Standings:
Upper Class

Crimson Hall

University Park (East Campus)
Crimson Hall, a co-ed residence, houses 408 upper-class students on five floors and features its own dining hall. Room styles consist of singles and doubles in a suite configuration. The most common suite configuration is two double rooms that share a common room and a bathroom. The hall is located on East Campus behind DiNardo Hall.

Available Room Types:
Suite Style with Living Room and Private Bath; Gender Neutral Bathrooms on the First Floor

Amenities:
Air Conditioning, Study Lounge on Each Floor, Kitchen on Each Floor, Game Room

Class Standings:
Upper Class

Stonehouse Hall

Lower Great Hill (East Campus)
This co-ed residence hall, houses 300 upper-class students on four floors. Room styles consist of singles and doubles in a suite configuration. The most common suite configuration is one double room with two single rooms. The hall is located on East Campus at the bottom of the Great Hill, next to East Campus Commons, which contains the closest dining hall.

Available Room Types:
Suite Style with Private Bath; Gender Neutral Bathrooms on First Floor

Amenities:
Air Conditioning, Study Lounge on Each Floor, Kitchen on Ground Floor, Game Room

Class Standings:
Upper Class

Weygand Hall

Lower Great Hill (East Campus)
Weygand Hall is a co-ed residence that houses 500 upper-class students on five floors. Room styles consist of singles and doubles in suite and pod configurations. The most common configuration is a four-bed suite. Weygand is home to the Upper-Class Residential Learning Communities. The hall is located on East Campus next to the Parking Garage and Stonehouse Hall. The Wellness Center, providing health and counseling services, is on the ground floor.

Available Room Types:
Suite Style with Living Room with One or Two Bathrooms Per Suite or Pod

Amenities:
Air Conditioning, Study Lounge on Each Floor, Kitchen on Each Floor, Game Room

Class Standings:
Upper Class, Upper-Class Residential Learning Communities

Scott Hall

West Campus
Scott Hall, a co-ed residence, houses 269 students, both first-year and upper-class students on five floors. Rooms are corridor style arranged in double and triple rooms. The hall is located on West Campus next to the Campus Center and across the street from Woodward Hall and the Boyden Quadrangle. The Flynn Dining Commons and the Bear's Den are located nearby.

Available Room Types:
Standard Rooms with Shared Single-Sex Bathrooms

Amenities:
Study Lounge on Each Floor, Kitchen on Ground Floor, Game Room

Class Standings:
Upper Class, First Year, First-Year

Most rooms in Scott Hall are approximately 15 feet by 13 feet. If you plan on bringing a rug it should be small enough to not interfere with the sweep of the door. We recommend purchasing a 6' x 9' rug.

Woodward Hall

West Campus
Woodward Hall, a co-ed residence, houses 231 first-year students. Rooms are corridor style arranged in triple and quad rooms. This residence hall is located on West Campus next to Harrington Hall and across the street from Scott Hall and the Boyden Quadrangle. The Flynn Dining Commons and the Bear's Den are nearby.

Available Room Types:
Standard Rooms with Shared Single-Sex and Gender Neutral Bathrooms on Each Floor

Amenities:
Study Lounge on Each Floor, Kitchen on Ground Floor, Game Room

Class Standings:
First Year

Most rooms in Woodward Hall are approximately 14 feet by 14 feet. If you plan on bringing a rug it should be small enough to not interfere with the sweep of the door. We recommend purchasing a 6' x 9' rug.

Pope Hall

West Campus
Pope Hall, a co-ed residence, houses 336 first-year and upper-class students. Rooms are corridor style arranged in double and triple rooms. The hall is located on West Campus next to the Dana Mohler Faria Science and Mathematics Center and across the street from the Campus Center. The Flynn Dining Commons and the Bear's Den are nearby.

Available Room Types:
Standard Rooms with Shared Single-Sex Bathrooms

Amenities:
Study Lounge on Each Floor, Kitchen on Ground Floor, Game Room

Class Standings:
Upper Class, First Year, Upper-Class Residential Learning Community, First-Year Residential Learning Community

Shea and Durgin Halls

Upper Great Hill (East Campus)
Shea Hall and Durgin Hall, both co-ed residences with some single-sex floors, housing approximately 658 first-year residents on five floors. Rooms are corridor style arranged in double, triple, and four-person rooms. The hall is located on the Great Hill. The East Campus Commons is the closest dining room.

Available Room Types:
Standard Rooms with Shared Single-Sex Bathrooms; Gender Neutral Bathrooms on Each Floor in Shea Hall.

Amenities:
Study Lounge on Each Floor, Kitchen on Ground Floor, Game Room

Class Standings:
First Year

Most rooms in Shea and Durgin Halls are approximately 15 feet by 11 feet. If you plan on bringing a rug it should be small enough to not interfere with the sweep of the door. We recommend purchasing a 6' x 9' rug.

Great Hill Student Apartments

Upper Great Hill (East Campus)
The Great Hill Student Apartments, a co-ed living community, houses 198 upper-class residents. The community is located on the Great Hill, near the Adrian Tinsley Center. Students live in six-person units with shared kitchen, living room and bathroom facilities. Handicap accessible units are also available. The nearest dining room is the East Campus Commons. Students who are 21 and over are allowed to have limited amounts of alcohol.

Available Room Types:
Six-Person Units with Single Rooms, 1.5 Baths, Kitchen, and Common Area

Amenities:
Common Building with Lounge, Laundry Room, and Resident Assistant/Resident Director Offices

Class Standings:
Upper Class
